definitions.arm: the arm of the lane NGSIM geometry assigns; no-lane if none
definitions.precision_proxy: detections matched to a reference / detections with a ground position; an unmatched box is not necessarily false
definitions.throughput: detect_fps: painting, scaling, tiling, model, class map and NMS, one frame per call, batch = the frame's tiles; float32; no decode. timing_pass is a dedicated run on spread dev frames, back to back under the heavy lock, and is the figure to quote; timing is the scoring run, which other work may have disturbed
definitions.vehicle_frame_recall: matched in-view reference vehicle-frames / in-view reference vehicle-frames
definitions.vram: torch allocator peak in the process (allocated, reserved); the CUDA context is extra, see gpu_after_run.device_used_mib, which also holds other processes

evidence_class: agreement with a correlated reference, not accuracy; dev frames only; confidences were chosen on the dev sample, and w1-w3 sit in dev blocks, so nothing here is a held-out result

dfine-l__tiled2x.basis: 120 dev frames on this GPU, one frame per call, float32
dfine-l__tiled2x.note: An estimate, not a run: the full span holds the odd blocks, which only the pre-registered gate may read.

visdrone-yolo26s__tiled2x.basis: 120 dev frames on this GPU, one frame per call, float32
visdrone-yolo26s__tiled2x.note: An estimate, not a run: the full span holds the odd blocks, which only the pre-registered gate may read.

fusion.note: run for the rule's winner and for the best Apache model, each at every fusion_iou; confidence and fusion_iou were chosen on the dev sample
fusion.rule: neural boxes kept whole; a blob box added where it overlaps no neural box by fusion_iou, then NMS among the added blobs

held_out_rule: block = floor((source_s - 120) / 60); odd blocks were not read

label_consistency.note: detector label by the class NGSIM's length implies, on matched pairs

selection.applied_on: the dev set (240 frames across all eight even blocks)
selection.governing: operating_point: each model at its own confidence on a 0.01 grid. Recall falls about 0.02 per 0.01 of confidence near the bar, so a three-point grid would compare where the grid happened to land, not the models.
selection.rule: Best Apache model at precision proxy >= 0.80. An AGPL model is eligible only if the best Apache trails it by 0.10 vehicle-frame recall or more. Blobs are fusion or fallback only.

unmatched_by_reference_coverage.note: dev set; coverage = image cells any reference footprint touched, grown by one 8 px cell. A diagnostic: the selection rule uses the proxy as defined.
